about: The small passage, chapter 5's second scene (D273): a corridor of the tower, the masonry behind its wall seen cut open from above with a familiars' trench narrower than a cell winding through it, and a forgotten room above. Painted by Gemini from the design's trial, its trench squeezed onto the middles of its cells by tools/art/narrow.py (narrow.json), its grid taken out by Gemini, and a second flap at the foot of the corridor's wall painted by Gemini on a part of it and laid on it, its own pixels only (`laid`, D281): the base, with the forgotten room's side door shut. The side door open is the owner's picture of a part of it with the door open, made with Gemini, laid on it in two runs, its doorway and its leaf (`laid`, D289), and the state `open` of the story's door `room_door`. Where a familiar walks under the painted wall, at the passage's two mouths, the wall is a box drawn over it (`over`). Pictures named here are in art/raw/, which git ignores.

corridor_mouth.about: The corridor's wall over the passage's lower mouth, from its lit top down to just above the floor: over a familiar on (10, 10), (10, 11) and (10, 12), which walks under it into the flap (D273).

room_mouth.about: The forgotten room's front wall over the passage's upper mouth, its lit top and its face with the flap: over a familiar on (13, 5) and (13, 4), which walks under it into the room (D273).

trench_rim.about: The trench's near rim along row 8, from the top of its dark outline, the trench's lower edge, down to where its pale stones end. The polygon runs inside the pale stones and the cut puts its edge on the outline's (D93); the fixed parts fill the rim below the outline, and its two ends from the outline's top, where the rim runs on into the rims of columns 10 and 13 with no outline between; the box keeps it below the trench's floor. Over a familiar on (10, 8) to (13, 8), whose feet stand behind the rim; no familiar on row 9 or below reaches it (D282).

arch_wall.about: The corridor's arch at the foot of the back stairs (D307): its stones round the opening, down to the floor, without the opening and the steps under it, which are floor and lie behind every figure; traced on the painting, drawn over a figure on rows 0 to 11, so that Rinlo coming down the last stairs on (2, 9) to (2, 11) is seen through the opening alone, and stands whole on the steps under the arch on (2, 12). Cut from the painting by its polygon less the opening and the steps (`holes`).

room_door_jamb.about: The stone block at the side doorway's foot, the wall in front of whoever crosses the doorway on (5, 3), drawn over that figure, whose feet it hides (D104, D289). The painting's own pixels, a box on the block's straight top and sides, measured on the painting: whatever of the figure it covers is the block's own.

room_door.about: The forgotten room's side door, in its left wall at (5, 3), onto the landing of the back stairs (D289): a story's door, resting shut, as the painting shows it. Shut, it is the ground's own and draws nothing. Open, it is the owner's picture of the door open laid on the painting (`laid`), cut by the difference in two pieces: the leaf, a square door standing on the landing beside the wall, on row 3, before which a figure on the landing passes (`passed_before`); and the doorway, the plank gone and the wall's strip of small stones whole, lying on the floor under every figure and covering the whole of the shut door; a figure crossing it passes before the wall behind and the leaf, its feet behind the block in front (`room_door_jamb`). Each mask is 0 or 1. The picture differs from the painting only where it was laid, so its difference is read at a threshold of 2, which takes all that was laid and nothing else; the doorway's piece takes the shut door's outline too (`covers`), so that nothing of the shut door shows.

laid.about: The corridor's second tiny entrance (D281), a twin of the trench's mouth on (10, 12): painted on the cell (16, 12), at the wall's foot to the right of the tapestry, and no more: the cell stays wall, nothing is under it and no one enters it. Painted by Gemini on the wall's part `part` of the painting without its grid, given with a mark where it goes (flap-wall.png, flap-wall-guide.png), and laid on that painting by tools/art/lay.py: the difference within `box` only.

The side door open (D289), its doorway: the plank gone and the wall's strip of small stones whole down to the doorway's foot, where a little of the floor shows before the stone block. From the owner's picture of the part `part` with the door open, made with Gemini from its edits of that part (the wall without the door, owner-wall-no-door.webp, and the leaf alone, owner-door-open.png) and the leaf set by hand where it stands, laid on the painting by tools/art/lay.py: the difference within `box` only, read with lowered settings (`diff`).

The side door open, its leaf: a square door standing on the landing beside the wall, as high as the shut door, its hinges on the wall's strip, from the same picture, laid on the doorway's picture: the difference within `box` only, read with lowered settings (`diff`), since the leaf's wood is near the shelves' colour, and a little darker (`tone`), as dark as the scene's other wood.

nudged.about: The forgotten room's side doorway, open (D289): a figure crossing it is drawn on the middle of the floor at the doorway's foot, between its two sides measured on the door-open picture at 5.545 and 5.96.
The trench's stretch up column 10: its painted floor's middle is 0.02 of a cell right of the cells', and a familiar's figure 0.005 left of its frame's, measured on the game's ground (D282).

The turn from column 10 into row 8, taken tight: a familiar facing along row 8 has its feet on row 8's side behind the trench's near rim and its others on column 10's floor, clear of the column's left rim, and its nose inside the corner (D282).
The stretch up column 13, measured as column 10's, off by as much.
The turn from row 8 into column 13, taken tight as the other: a familiar facing along row 8 has its nose inside the column's right rim.

lowered.about: The forgotten room's side doorway and the landing of the back stairs (D289, D307): a figure crossing the doorway is drawn lower, its feet on the middle of the cell below, behind the stone block at the doorway's near end, which is drawn over it (`room_door_jamb`) and hides it up to the chest; on the landing it stays as low, its feet below the open leaf's foot, going down once and staying down.
The room's floor before its side doorway (D307): a figure drawn lower, between the stool and the candle's box.
The last stairs behind the corridor's arch (D307): a figure drawn lower, so that its legs show in the arch's opening as it comes down.
The last stair behind the corridor's arch (D307): a figure drawn lower, its feet on the top step under the opening.
Under the room's front wall's lit top: a familiar drawn lower, so that it is wholly under the wall until it steps into the room.

source:
# The small passage

Kydux's own art, made for the game and under the GNU GPL, version 3 or
later, like the rest of it.

- Painted by Gemini 3 Pro Image (`gemini-3-pro-image`) from
  `tools/art/prompts/scene-small-passage.md`, in the style of
  `art/raw/image-first/field-2k.png`, and edited by it
  (`scene-small-passage-2.md`, `scene-small-passage-3.md`).
- Its trench painted by it on an enlargement of the wall
  (`scene-small-passage-6.md`), squeezed onto the middles of its cells by
  `tools/art/narrow.py`, repaired by it (`scene-small-passage-7.md`), its
  rubble painted again (`scene-small-passage-8.md`), and laid back by
  `tools/art/narrow.py`.
- Its grid taken out by it (`game-tower-passage-nogrid.md`).
- Its second flap painted by it on a part of the corridor's wall
  (`tower-passage-flap.md`) and laid on the painting by `tools/art/lay.py`,
  only its own pixels.
- The forgotten room's side door open painted by Gemini for the game's
  owner on a part of the painting, the wall without the door and the leaf
  alone, the leaf set in its place by the owner; laid on the painting by
  `tools/art/lay.py`, its doorway and its leaf, only their own pixels, the
  leaf a little darker.
- The corridor's arch's wall is cut from the painting by
  `tools/art/export_scene.py`, a polygon round it less its opening.

grid.about: The grid's own pencil (D337): the common dark brown is lost on the passage's dark stone, so the cells' lines are drawn in the pale yellow of the torches' light, a little stronger than the common pencil.
